statement: Grok Build's pinned source resolves semantic allow, ask, and deny policy separately from OS sandbox activation; the sandbox manager exposes requested and active state, uses platform backends where supported, and can explicitly continue without sandboxing when unsupported or application fails.

display_text.zh-CN: 固定版本的 Grok Build 源码把语义层 allow、ask、deny policy 与 OS sandbox 激活分开处理；sandbox manager 暴露 requested/active 状态，在支持的平台使用系统 backend，并在不支持或应用失败时明确可能继续无 sandbox 运行。
display_text.en: Grok Build's pinned source separates semantic allow/ask/deny policy from OS sandbox activation; the manager exposes requested and active state, uses supported platform backends, and may explicitly continue unsandboxed when unsupported or application fails.

evidence.title: Grok Build permission resolution
evidence.locator: permission decision resolution and deny precedence

notes: This deliberately rejects a universal fail-closed interpretation. Effective isolation is platform- and run-dependent and requires Native verification.
